reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Re-read the underlying programme tables in both adopted 2026–2027 appendices and the exact target curriculum page. Compared their individual credit values, codes, terms and thesis entry rules before rechecking which claims the active exception and provisional UCR record support.
findings: The Culture route has ten compulsory first-year courses and eight common second-year courses. The 12 EC Culture placement is in second-year spring, while the Teacher choice instead requires two six-credit modules. The three zero-credit GROW units do not change the totals. The published 30 EC elective semester, Truth and Fiction and 12 EC thesis are common across the sources. Together these support 168 listed EC.

The Dutch spring table prints 12 EC for Language and Diversity and sums to 36 despite its 30 EC heading. The English table and exact target page print 6 EC. Both adopted tables show Educational Science but the target page lists Sociology of Education. Art. 2.5(d) names Digital Data and Digital Techniques as a thesis gate in both versions, but the track table includes only two of the three prescribed methods courses. The 120 EC threshold alone is feasible, but does not establish full entry. The separate family track contains the missing module and cannot establish the Culture route requirement. Internship rules are also pending.

The repaired UCR options have three distinct emphases: interpretation and public heritage, digital media and the social implications of AI, and language, development and education in society. The workbook supports the moved Psycholinguistics and Modern Sociology courses, the AI Ethics substitution and each progression sequence. The active exception reports the precise third-year and entry uncertainty. The provisional curricula do not imply placement or a teaching qualification. Verified note anchors, exact titles, selected descriptions and optional research treatment against the frozen records.
